last.verdict: Operating profit fell 15% again; the raised earnings forecast comes mostly from lower taxes and other income, not a better underlying business.

takeaways.label: Profit still sliding
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income fell 15.2% to $939M on higher freight and ingredient costs, bigger bonuses and more advertising. The full-year profit forecast is unchanged at down 16% to 18%.

takeaways.label: Earnings raise is thin
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS guidance rose to $2.07-$2.13 from $2.03-$2.09. The release cites a lower tax rate (23.5% vs 24.5%) and higher other income. The operating profit outlook did not move.

takeaways.label: North America still weak
takeaways.text: U.S.-heavy North America sales fell 3.4%, with volumes down 2.4% and prices cut 0.8%. Meats, sauces and drinks lagged. Part of the volume drop reflects shipments pulled forward into Q2.

takeaways.label: Sales outlook nudged
takeaways.text: The low end of the 2026 organic sales forecast improved to down 1.25% from down 2%. That range includes about 1 point of drag from cuts to SNAP food aid. Emerging markets grew 15.6%.

history.verdict: Investors sold the stock as profit kept shrinking while spending on brands rose.

reasons.label: Profit falling sharply
reasons.text: Adjusted operating income fell 18.4% to $1.0B as advertising and costs rose.

reasons.label: Spending raised again
reasons.text: Extra 2026 brand investment rose $100M to about $700M, weighing on near-term profit.

reasons.label: Sales still shrinking
reasons.text: Sales fell 1.3% as meats and Lunchables-type products lagged; outlook only trimmed to down 0.5-2%.
